Neighborhood guide

The 86303 area extends into the pine forests east and south of downtown Prescott. Lynx Lake offers year-round fishing, kayaking, and camping. Goldwater Lake provides a quieter recreation alternative. The Granite Mountain Wilderness preserves rugged terrain and the Granite Mountain Trail, one of Arizona's premier hikes. Thumb Butte offers an accessible climb with panoramic views. The Prescott Lakes master-planned community features golf and residential amenities amid the pines.

Frequently asked questions

Can you provide hiking transportation to Granite Mountain?

Yes! Granite Mountain is one of Arizona's best hikes with spectacular views. We drop you at the trailhead and return to pick you up after your adventure. The 7.5-mile round trip is challenging but rewarding.

Do you offer transportation to Lynx Lake?

We provide transportation to Lynx Lake Recreation Area for fishing, kayaking, hiking, and picnicking. It's a perfect day trip destination from Phoenix with cool mountain air and beautiful scenery.

How much cooler is Prescott than Phoenix?

Prescott sits at 5,300 feet elevation and is typically 15-20 degrees cooler than Phoenix. Summer highs average mid-80s compared to Phoenix's 100s+, making it a popular summer escape destination.
